# tmds_policy (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Deep Security policy by name and returns this manager's local ID. Use it to reference a parent policy (e.g. `Base Policy`) portably across managers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve an existing policy by name to this manager's local ID. Names are
# stable across managers; IDs are not, so look them up rather than hardcode.
data "tmds_policy" "base" {
  name = "Base Policy"
}

output "base_policy_id" {
  value = data.tmds_policy.base.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact policy name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) DSM-assigned policy ID on this manager.
- `parent_id` (Number) The policy's parent ID, if any.
